title: Proactive Defense: Compound AI for Detecting Persuasion Attacks and Measuring Inoculation Effectiveness
reasoning: The paper explicitly evaluates and benchmarks models on 'moral value recognition' and 'moral foundations'. It includes quantitative results and analysis (e.g., in Tables 1 and 2) for moral dimensions such as Authority, Fairness, Harm, and Ingroup as part of its socio-emotional-cognitive evaluation framework.
